Card actions follow from the categories of the disputes actually filed; a dispute held back by the open-dispute limit, or dropped by the customer after a record check, sets no card action. rejected.done_when:
All of the following hold:
- The customer is verified and the verification is logged (once per conversation, reused when the job comes from a transaction review or the PIN lock investigation).
- Every requested dispute that passes the pre-filing rules and fits the account's open-dispute limit has been filed with file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281, one per transaction_id, with every argument set by its case. Existing open disputes, and disputes filed earlier in this conversation, were counted per account.
- Where the customer's amount differed from the record, the customer was told the recorded amount, and the dispute was filed with the recorded amount or not filed because the customer dropped it. A Rho-Bank ATM claim the record did not support was explained and filed only if the customer still wanted it.
- Any dispute held back by a rule, the limit, a failed match, or deposit records the customer accepted has been explained; a held-back or dropped dispute set no card action.
- Each card's most severe action among its filed disputes has been performed once, after the last dispute: a freeze; a closure with reason lost, stolen or fraud_suspected (a frozen card unfrozen first only with the customer's agreement), plus a replacement if the customer wanted one and the tier allows it now, or the Entry-tier 48-hour wait explained; or nothing for keep_active. A customer-initiated fraud alert on a disputed card was not cleared.
- If a closed card was lost or stolen, the cross-product credit card check has been handed off.
- The customer has a per-dispute summary of liability, provisional credit, timelines, any affidavit and card status.
- A PIN-locked card with no successful unauthorized transactions had no dispute filed; the security concern was explained and the PIN lock options offered.
- A late existing dispute was offered for escalation and transferred only with the customer's agreement after the new disputes were handled; a failed call was explained and a transfer offered; a transfer on request happened only on the 4th request.
